title: In Vivo Smooth Muscle Cell-Specific CRISPRi Perturb-seq Baseline Condition
author: João Pinho Monteiro
materials: Chromium GEM-X Single Cell 3’ Kit v4
Reagents Tamoxifen (Sigma-Aldrich; CAS T5648-1G) Sunflower seed oil (Sigma-Aldrich; CAS S5007-259ML) 100% Ethanol Oral gavage needles (appropriate gauge/length for adult mice) + syringes

Endpoint : - Sacrifice at 5 weeks following the schedule above. Reagents: - Liberase TM medium Thermolysin (Roche #05401127001) - Reconstituted in HBSS to 26 units/mL. - After reconstitution, divide into single-use aliquots, as performance degrades significantly withfreeze-thaw. - Elastase (Worthington #LS002279), stock solution has variable concentration - HBSS, calcium, magnesium, no phenol red (Gibco # 14025092) - PBS Equipment: - Fine dissection scissors (e.g. FST 14058-09) - 5mL Round Bottom Polystyrene FACS Tubes w/ 35um Strainer Cap (Falcon # 352235). - Pre-cooled centrifuge at 4°C w/ swing bucket

steps.title: Prepare 20 mg/mL Tamoxifen Solution
steps.instruction: Mix 9 parts sunflower oil with 1 part ethanol (e.g., 900 µL oil + 100 µL EtOH) to make the vehicle, weigh 20 mg tamoxifen, add 1 mL of the oil/EtOH vehicle to obtain a 20 mg/mL solution, let dissolve overnight at 37 °C, then store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Combine 900 µL sunflower oil and 100 µL ethanol.
Weigh 20 mg tamoxifen and add to 1 mL vehicle.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C until fully dissolved.
Store the solution at 4 °C; use within 1 week.

steps.title: Administer Tamoxifen by Oral Gavage
steps.instruction: At 7–8 weeks of age give two oral gavage doses of the 20 mg/mL tamoxifen solution, each at ~0.2 mg per gram body weight, spaced 72–96 h apart (e.g., a 30 g mouse receives 6 mg → 0.3 mL).

substeps.instruction: Calculate dose: 0.2 mg × body weight (g).
Convert to volume using 20 mg/mL stock (volume = dose ÷ 20 mg/mL).
Administer first dose by oral gavage.
Wait 72–96 h, then administer second dose.

steps.title: Dilute AAV‑PR Virus
steps.instruction: Thaw the AAV‑PR stock on ice, aliquot any unused portion and refreeze on dry ice at –80 °C, then dilute in sterile DPBS to a final concentration of 1 × 10¹² vg/mL, preparing 100 µL per mouse and loading into a U‑100 BD Ultra‑Fine Short Insulin Syringe, 31G (BD #BD328438) while minimizing bubbles.

substeps.instruction: Thaw AAV vial on ice.
If not using the whole vial, aliquot and snap‑freeze on dry ice; store at –80 °C.
Dilute in sterile DPBS to 1 × 10¹² vg/mL, making enough 100 µL aliquots for each mouse.
Load each 100 µL into a 31G insulin syringe, avoiding bubbles.

steps.title: Retro‑Orbital Injection of AAV
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse in an induction chamber with isoflurane 3–4 % at 0.8–1.0 L/min, maintain at 1–2 % via nose cone, place the mouse on its side, apply a drop of 0.5 % proparacaine to the eye, insert a 27–30 G, ½" needle at a 30–45° angle into the retro‑orbital sinus, inject 100 µL slowly, then recover the mouse on a heated pad and monitor every 15 min until ambulatory.

substeps.instruction: Place mouse in induction chamber; start isoflurane 3–4 % (0.8–1.0 L/min).
When breathing slows (~1 breath/s), reduce to 1–2 % isoflurane with nose cone.
Position mouse on its side and gently press the eyelids to protrude the globe.
Apply one drop of 0.5 % proparacaine HCl, wait a few seconds, dab excess with sterile gauze.
Using a 1 mL syringe (or smaller) with a 27–30 G, ½" needle, insert at 30–45° angle, bevel down, lateral to medial canthus, advance to the bony orbit, retract slightly, and inject 100 µL slowly.
Withdraw needle smoothly, close eyelids, apply gentle pressure with gauze.
Transfer mouse to a paper‑lined cage on a heating pad; monitor every 15 min until fully ambulatory.

steps.title: Prepare Enzyme Digestion Mix
steps.instruction: On ice, make 1 mL of enzyme solution containing Liberase TM (77 µL of 26 U/mL stock) and Elastase (16 µL of 125 U/mL stock) to achieve final working concentrations of 2 U/mL each, and add 907 µL HBSS; keep the mixture on ice until use.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 77 µL Liberase TM (26 U/mL).
Pipette 16 µL Elastase (125 U/mL).
Add 907 µL HBSS.
Mix gently and keep on ice.

steps.title: Perfuse Mouse and Harvest Aortic Root
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mouse with isoflurane 3–4 % (0.8–1.0 L/min) to surgical depth, perform a midline incision, open the thoracic cavity, incise the right atrium for exsanguination, insert a 25–27 G needle into the left ventricle or ascending aorta and perfuse ~10 mL sterile PBS until tissues blanch and effluent runs clear, then dissect the aortic root, open it longitudinally, and wash three times with PBS in a 12‑well dish on ice.

substeps.instruction: Induce anesthesia (3–4 % isoflurane, 0.8–1.0 L/min).
Make a midline skin incision over abdomen and thorax.
Open abdominal cavity, puncture diaphragm, complete thoracotomy.
Incise right atrium to allow blood drainage.
Insert 25–27 G needle into left ventricle or ascending aorta.
Perfuse ~10 mL sterile PBS until tissues blanch and outflow is clear.
Harvest the aortic root, open longitudinally.
Wash the root three times with PBS in a 12‑well plate; keep on ice.

steps.title: Digest Aortic Tissue to Single Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the washed aortic root to a 12‑well dish containing 1 mL of the enzyme mix, incubate at 37 °C for 30–45 min (adjust for age or calcification), mince on ice ≤5 min, pipet up/down 20–30 times, verify single‑cell suspension under a microscope, optionally incubate an additional 10–15 min at 37 °C if needed, then centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 min, remove supernatant, resuspend the pellet in ~300 µL HBSS (adjust as needed), and pass through a 35 µm strainer (tubes may be coated with 10 % BSA to improve viability).

substeps.instruction: Place aortic root in 1 mL enzyme solution.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30–45 min (longer for older or calcified tissue).
Mince tissue with scissors on ice for ≤5 min until mostly dissolved.
Pipet the suspension up/down 20–30 times.
Examine under a microscope; if clumps remain, incubate additional 10–15 min at 37 °C (avoid prolonged incubation).
Transfer suspension to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube and centrifuge 500 × g for 5 min.
Carefully discard supernatant, keeping the cell pellet.
Resuspend cells in ~300 µL HBSS (volume may be adjusted).
Pass the suspension through a 35 µm cell strainer; optionally pre‑coat collection tubes with 10 % BSA.

steps.title: FACS Sort tdT⁺/GFP⁺ Cells
steps.instruction: Using flow cytometry, sort the dual‑positive tdTomato⁺ (SMC‑derived) and GFP⁺ (AAV‑transduced) cell population for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Prepare 10x Genomics Single‑Cell Library
steps.instruction: Pool tdT⁺/GFP⁺ cells from 3–5 mice to obtain >8,000 cells per run, then follow the 10x Genomics Chromium GEM‑X Single Cell 3’ v4 workflow using the following reagents: Chromium GEM‑X Single Cell 3’ Kit v4 (PN‑1000691), Gel Bead v4 (PN‑2001128), Chip Kit v4 (PN‑1000690), Dual Index Kit TT Set A (PN‑1000215), Dual Index Kit NT Set A (PN‑1000242), and 3’ Feature Barcode Kit (PN‑1000262). Execute the standard Gene Expression protocol (User Guide CG000731) and the Feature Barcoding protocol (User Guide CG000389), specifically Step 2.3C followed by Step 4 for guide‑library construction.

substeps.instruction: Pool sorted cells from 3–5 mice to reach >8,000 cells.
Load cells into the Chromium GEM‑X chip with the listed reagents.
Run the Gene Expression workflow per CG000731.
Run the Feature Barcoding workflow per CG000389, performing Step 2.3C then Step 4 for guide library preparation.

description: Abstract (JPM Edited 2/25/26) This protocol describes an in vivo smooth muscle cell (SMC)-specificPerturb-seq workflow enabling targeted gene repression and single-cell transcriptional profiling during atherosclerosis. Using Myh11 CreERT2 ; ROSA tdT/+ ; dCas9 KRAB mice, dCas9-KRAB expression is induced in adult SMCs via tamoxifen administration. One week after tamoxifen induction, mice receive a single systemic AAV injection via retro-orbital delivery under isoflurane anesthesia to introduce sgRNAs targeting genes of interest or non-targeting controls. At defined endpoints, aortic roots are harvested and enzymatically dissociated to generate single-cell suspensions. Dual-positive tdTomato⁺/GFP-reporter⁺ cells are isolated by FACS and processed using the 10x Genomics Chromium platform for single-cell RNA sequencing and CRISPR guide capture. This integrated workflow enables high-resolution, lineage-traced functional genomics in vivo , allowing assessment of SMC state transitions and gene regulatory perturbations. Conditional smooth muscle cell dCas9-KRAB knock-in allele with lineage tracing [JPM2] We have obtained several lines of genetically modified mice from other laboratories, and combined alleles to undertake experiments outlined in here. To lineage trace vascular smooth muscle cells (SMC), we employed a SMC-specific mouse Cre allele ( Myh11 CreERT2 ; Tg Myh11-CreERT2 ; 019079; JAX) combined with a Cre-responsive reporter gene (tandem dimer Tomato, tdT ) inserted at the ROSA26 locus ( ROSA tdT/+ ; B6.Cg-Gt(ROSA)26Sor tm14(CAGtdTomato)Hze /J ; 007914; JAX). Adding a conditional dCas9-KRAB knock-in ( dCas9 KRAB ; B6.129S6- Gt(ROSA)26Sor tm2(CAG-cas9*/ZNF10*)Gers /J; 033066; JAX) mutation with these alleles has created the experimental mice, Myh11 CreERT2 , dCas9 KRAB , ROSA tdT/+ that are both lineage traced for the SMC lineage and have SMC specific expression of dCas9-KRAB .
